moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe in Full Swing
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Fringe, is captivating audiences across the Scottish capital throughout August.

angles.name: General Buzz
angles.copy: Edinburgh's alive with the sound of the Fringe! What's the best show you've seen or heard about so far?

angles.name: Comedy Focus
angles.copy: From stand-up to improv, the Edinburgh Fringe is a comedy goldmine right now. Who are you hoping to catch?

moments.title: Edinburgh Tattoo Spectacle
moments.blurb: The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo is delivering its spectacular show, 'A Call to Gather', against the backdrop of Edinburgh Castle this August.

angles.name: Visual Spectacle
angles.copy: The pipes and drums are in full flow! The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo is a must-see. Who's been lucky enough to go?

angles.name: Tradition & Music
angles.copy: More than just a show, it's a tradition! The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo is bringing its iconic blend of music and military display to Edinburgh Castle. Goosebumps guaranteed.

moments.title: Community Shield Countdown
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield, the traditional curtain-raiser for the English football season, takes place next Sunday in Cardiff, with Premier League champions Arsenal facing FA Cup winners Manchester City.

angles.name: Match Build-up
angles.copy: Just over a week until the Community Shield! Arsenal vs Man City at the Principality Stadium. Who's taking home the first silverware of the season?

angles.name: Cardiff Host
angles.copy: Cardiff is buzzing to host the FA Community Shield next Sunday! Arsenal vs Man City at Principality Stadium – a huge event for the capital!

moments.title: Summer Holidays Continue
moments.blurb: School summer holidays are in full swing across the UK, with families making the most of the break before the new academic year begins.

angles.name: Family Fun
angles.copy: Summer holidays are still on! What's been your favourite family day out or adventure so far?

angles.name: Local Activities
angles.copy: Devon families, how are you making the most of the last few weeks of summer holidays? Any local gems you've discovered?

moments.title: Happy 65th to The Edge!
moments.blurb: U2's iconic guitarist, The Edge (David Howell Evans), celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 65th birthday to the one and only The Edge! His distinctive guitar sound has defined U2 for decades. What's your favourite U2 track?

angles.name: U2 Tribute
angles.copy: It's The Edge's 65th birthday! From 'With or Without You' to 'Vertigo', his riffs are unmistakable. Let's celebrate the U2 legend!

moments.title: Kylie Jenner Turns 29
moments.blurb: Reality TV star and businesswoman Kylie Jenner celebrates her 29th birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Celebrity Culture
angles.copy: Kylie Jenner turns 29 this Monday! The youngest of the Kardashian-Jenner clan has certainly made her mark. What's been her biggest impact?

angles.name: Business & Influence
angles.copy: From reality TV to a beauty empire, Kylie Jenner celebrates her 29th on Monday. A true modern mogul!

moments.title: Mark Knopfler's 77th
moments.blurb: Dire Straits frontman and legendary guitarist Mark Knopfler celebrates his 77th birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Guitar Master
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the incomparable Mark Knopfler! His unique fingerstyle guitar work for Dire Straits is legendary. What's your favourite solo?

angles.name: Dire Straits Hits
angles.copy: From 'Sultans of Swing' to 'Money for Nothing', Mark Knopfler gave us some of rock's greatest hits. Wishing him a very happy 77th today!

moments.title: Steve Martin Turns 81
moments.blurb: The multi-talented comedian, actor, writer, and musician Steve Martin celebrates his 81st birthday on Thursday.

angles.name: Comedy & Music
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the brilliant Steve Martin! A true renaissance man of comedy, film, and music. What's your favourite Steve Martin moment?

angles.name: Banjo Man
angles.copy: Did you know Steve Martin is also an accomplished banjo player? Wishing the legend a very happy 81st birthday!

moments.title: Joe Jonas Turns 37

angles.name: Pop Heartthrob
angles.copy: Happy 37th birthday to Joe Jonas! From Jonas Brothers to DNCE, he's given us some serious pop bangers. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Jonas Brothers Fan
angles.copy: It's Joe Jonas's birthday! Time to blast some Jonas Brothers tunes. What's your go-to track?

moments.title: Madonna's 68th Birthday
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, celebrates her 68th birthday on Saturday.

angles.name: Queen of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to the one and only Madonna! Her influence on music, fashion, and culture is unmatched. What's your favourite Madonna era?

angles.name: Iconic Hits
angles.copy: From 'Like a Prayer' to 'Vogue', Madonna has given us countless anthems. Let's celebrate the Queen of Pop on her 68th birthday!

moments.title: Belinda Carlisle Turns 68

angles.name: Go-Go's & Solo
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Belinda Carlisle! From The Go-Go's to 'Heaven Is a Place on Earth', she's a true 80s icon. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Belinda Carlisle's 68th birthday! Her voice defined an era. What's the first song that comes to mind?

moments.title: UK Singles Chart #1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the top spot on the Official UK Singles Chart for a record-breaking 60th week.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at #1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are making history with 'Rein Me In' on the Official Singles Chart. Are you still loving it?

angles.name: New Entries
angles.copy: Ariana Grande's new album 'petal' has landed a new entry at #4 on the Official Singles Chart! What other new tracks are you feeling this week?

moments.title: ArcTanGent Festival Approaching
moments.blurb: The ArcTanGent Festival, known for its experimental and heavy music, kicks off next Wednesday in Bristol.

angles.name: Festival Excitement

angles.name: Music Genre Focus
angles.copy: If you're into math-rock, post-rock, and metal, ArcTanGent is THE festival for you next week. Any predictions for standout sets?
